crossRefs.note: When they had preached the Good News to that city, and had made many disciples, they returned to Lystra, Iconium, and…
Therefore those who were scattered abroad went around preaching the word.
They therefore who were scattered abroad by the oppression that arose about Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia…
Paul, as was his custom, went in to them, and for three Sabbath days reasoned with them from the Scriptures,
but having suffered before and been shamefully treated, as you know, at Philippi, we grew bold in our God to tell you…
preach the word; be urgent in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and exhort with all patience and teaching.

translations.web: There they preached the Good News.
